product.name: TAGAS Men's Regular Fit Carrot Tapered Jeans
product.description: Men's regular-fit denim jeans with a carrot-style tapered leg, mid-rise waist and washed finish. Made from a cotton-rich denim blend with viscose and polyester, designed for casual everyday wear.

review_summary.summary: Customer feedback is mixed. Several buyers praise the fabric, comfort, fit, color and stitching, while other buyers report color differences from the product images, oversized or inconsistent fitting, poor stitching quality, zipper problems and weak value for money.

buying_advice.size_advice: The listing provides sizes 28 through 40. Because review feedback includes both perfect-fit and oversized-fit experiences, customers should check the size chart before ordering.
buying_advice.color_advice: Customers should be aware that some reviewers reported receiving a color that looked different from the product images.
buying_advice.quality_advice: Do not position this as premium-quality denim. The reviews are mixed, with both strong quality praise and complaints about stitching and overall finishing.
buying_advice.sales_advice: Lead with the ₹779 price, cotton-rich denim, regular fit, tapered carrot silhouette, mid-rise design and six color choices. Do not hide the mixed review signal if the customer asks about quality or reliability.
buying_advice.review_advice: The 3.4-star rating and 420 global ratings should be treated as a meaningful warning signal. The 22% 1-star share is particularly important when recommending this product.

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_product: Give a concise overview covering the regular fit, carrot/tapered leg, mid-rise waist, denim composition, price, colors, sizes and the most important review insights.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_if_good: Recommend conditionally. Highlight the low ₹779 price, cotton-rich denim, regular tapered design and positive comfort/fit reviews, but clearly mention the 3.4 rating and complaints about color, stitching and zipper quality.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_fit: Explain that the official fit is regular with a tapered/carrot leg and mid-rise waist. Mention that some buyers reported a perfect fit while at least one buyer reported an oversized fit. Recommend checking the size chart.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_quality: Give a balanced answer. Some customers praise the fabric and stitching, while others report poor quality and stitching defects. Do not describe the product as premium quality.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_color: Explain that six local product images are available: Black, Blue, Cream, Dark Blue, Green and Medium Blue. Also disclose that some reviewers reported the received color looked different from the listing images.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_comfort: Mention that several positive reviews describe the fabric as soft and comfortable, but avoid claiming universally high comfort because the overall review sentiment is mixed.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_reviews: Explain that the product has a 3.4/5 rating from 420 global ratings and 152 customer reviews. Highlight both positive feedback about fabric, fit and comfort and negative feedback about color mismatch, stitching, zipper and value.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_sizing: Available sizes are 28, 30, 32, 34, 36, 38 and 40. Because fit feedback is mixed, recommend checking the size chart before purchase.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_price: The captured listing price is ₹779 against an MRP of ₹2,999, representing a 74% discount.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_alternatives: If the customer prioritizes reliability or premium quality, prefer products with stronger ratings and fewer quality complaints. If the customer prioritizes low price and casual tapered styling, this product can remain an option.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_best_product: Do not recommend this product solely because of its low price. Consider the customer's preferred fit, color, quality expectations, budget and tolerance for mixed reviews.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_daily_wear: This product can be recommended for casual and daily wear because several reviewers describe it as comfortable and suitable for everyday use.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_value: The product is inexpensive at the captured price of ₹779, but value feedback is mixed. Some customers consider it worthwhile while others explicitly say it is not value for money.
